year.scope: Whole held year excluded from every target band before association. Frozen r-anchor additions and independent no-NSC-r anchor route separated; non-r r magnitudes come from actual SDSS r and are labelled. All bands eligible by physical quality; object IDs never enter training association. One-to-one 1arcsec held matches and four displaced-position controls. Conditional residuals are not absolute dark-star PM truth.
year.limitations: Candidate counts only, not adopted reliable stars. Unknown identities/blends are not successes; native W0 shared-night errors are uncalibrated. Footprints of qualified exposures do not prove a faint target had sufficient SNR. Object-centroid/halo retrieval selection remains; the source acquisition receipt identifies whether the historical r-object cut was removed. No adopted full catalogue until independent source/error/zero validation.

members.scope: Post-fit stationary spectral positions identify source and individual training members; PM similarity never labels identity. Unknown members and nonspectral sources are not declared correct. Neighbor/deblend indicates suspicion, not image-level blend truth. Zero known errors in finite samples retains Wilson intervals. No source selection or fitting changed.
members.uncertainty_scope: Spectral-zero intervals resample objects only. Shared physical groups require separate uncertainty/zero certification; their common error cannot be averaged down by source count.
